contact.securityDesc: Your data is our priority! We use advanced tech and monitoring systems to keep every transaction fully secure.
contact.dealsDesc: Smart tools and expert guidance to help you close deals quickly, confidently, and stress-free.
contact.address: Safqa is a fully digital marketplace—no physical office required
contact.socialDesc: Be the first to know about exclusive offers and hot deals on Safqa
contact.note: We commit to responding to every inquiry within 4 working hours
contact.thanks: Thanks for being part of the Safqa community! Here, used products turn into new opportunities for success

intro.title: Introduction
intro.text: At Safqa, we take your privacy seriously and are committed to protecting your personal information. This policy explains how we collect, use, protect, and maintain the confidentiality of your information.

collectedInfo.title: Information We Collect
collectedInfo.text: We may collect information necessary to provide Safqa's services and improve the user experience, including:

info.name: Name or username.
info.email: Email address and contact information associated with the account.
info.image: Profile picture or images that the user chooses to upload to the platform.

collectedInfo.technical: Technical information such as device type, operating system, IP address, and usage data necessary to operate and improve the service.

points.p1: Creating and managing user accounts and providing platform services.
points.p2: Enabling users to publish listings, communicate, and complete buying and selling transactions.
points.p3: Improving platform performance, developing features and services, and enhancing the user experience.
points.p4: Protecting the platform and its users from fraud, misuse, and unauthorized activities.

consent.title: User Consent
consent.text: By using the Safqa platform and creating an account, you acknowledge that you have read this Privacy Policy and understand how your information is collected and used in accordance with this policy.

points.external: We do not sell users' personal information. Some information may be shared with trusted service providers when necessary to operate the platform and provide its services.
points.law: We may disclose information when required by law, in response to a valid legal request, or to protect the rights of the platform and its users.

protection.title: Information Security
protection.text: We use appropriate technical and organizational measures to help protect user information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no electronic system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

updates.title: Privacy Policy Updates
updates.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services or legal requirements. The updated version will be published on this page together with the date of the latest revision.

points.p1: Request information about the personal data associated with your account.
points.p2: Request correction or updating of inaccurate information.
points.p3: Request deletion of your account and personal information, subject to legal requirements and obligations necessary to provide the service.
points.p4: File a complaint with the Israeli Privacy Protection Authority if you believe that the processing of your information violates applicable law.

retention.title: Data Retention Period
retention.text: We retain your personal information for as long as your account remains active on the platform. When an account is deleted, the information may be deleted or anonymized within a reasonable period, except where retention is required for legal, accounting, or dispute resolution purposes.

messages.title: Messages Between Users
messages.text: We do not routinely monitor the content of private messages between users. Message records may be retained for a limited period for operational and security purposes. Message content will not be disclosed to any external party except pursuant to a court order or an official request from a competent authority in accordance with applicable law.

external.title: Service Providers and Data Transfers
external.text: We do not sell users' personal information. Information may be shared with service providers necessary to operate the platform, such as payment, hosting, sign-in, and notification service providers. As a result, some information may be transferred to servers outside Israel, subject to appropriate data protection standards and safeguards.

userConsent.title: User Consent to Communications
userConsent.text: We may contact you regarding your account, listings, transactions, security, important notifications, or service-related updates. You can manage certain types of notifications through your account settings.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.text: If you have any questions or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal information, you can contact the Safqa team through the Contact Us page.
contact.phone: You may also use the official communication channels available within the Safqa platform.

disputes.title: Resolve Disputes
disputes.subtitle: Your trust matters to us. We are here to support you when a dispute occurs and ensure a transparent and fair process for everyone.
disputes.processSubtitle: Follow these steps to resolve any dispute quickly and fairly

step1.title: Communicate First
step1.desc: In most cases, disputes can be resolved through direct communication and mutual respect. Try to negotiate wisely and be patient with the other party.
step1.tip1: Be clear and specific about your requests

step2.title: Report the Problem
step2.desc: If no solution is reached, use the report button within the transaction. Provide clear evidence such as photos, conversations, and product details.
step2.tip2: Write a detailed description of the problem

step3.title: Dispute Review
step3.desc: The Safqa team reviews the details and compares the information provided by both parties. We verify the evidence and apply the platform policies.
step3.tip1: Be prepared to provide additional information

step4.title: Support and Assistance
step4.desc: We contact you to find a fair solution that protects the rights of all parties. We provide recommendations and final decisions based on our policies.
step4.tip2: Make sure you understand the outcome

disputes.issue1: Product does not match the description
disputes.issue3: Payment was made but the product was not received
disputes.issue5: Price differs from the agreed price
disputes.resolutionSubtitle: We offer several ways to resolve disputes depending on the nature of the problem

resolution1.title: Amicable Settlement
resolution1.desc: An agreement between both parties on a mutually acceptable solution with platform supervision.

resolution2.title: Direct Intervention
resolution2.desc: A decision by the support team based on the available evidence and applicable policies.

resolution3.title: Final Resolution
resolution3.desc: A final decision with disciplinary measures when necessary, such as account suspension.

disputes.finalNote: Our goal at Safqa is to build a fair, transparent, and secure C2C marketplace for everyone. We remain neutral and act based on the available evidence and published policies.

safety.title: Safety First
safety.subtitle: At Safqa, we are committed to providing a safe buying and selling experience for everyone. Follow these guidelines to help ensure safe and secure transactions.

tip1.title: Verify the Other Party
tip1.desc: Review the user's ratings and activity history before completing a transaction. Check previous reviews and the number of successful transactions.

tip2.title: Avoid Upfront Payments
tip2.desc: Do not transfer money before receiving the product or verifying its condition. Prefer payment upon delivery or secure payment methods for larger transactions.

tip3.title: Choose a Safe Location
tip3.desc: For in-person delivery, meet in a public and well-lit place such as a shopping center or a designated meeting location. Avoid isolated areas.

tip4.title: Watch Out for Suspicious Offers
tip4.desc: An unusually low price or unjustified urgency may be a sign of fraud. Inspect the product personally when possible and make sure it matches the description.

safety.warning1: Request to pay outside the platform
safety.warning2: Pressure to complete the transaction quickly
safety.warning3: Avoiding an in-person meeting without a reason
safety.warning4: Used products that appear brand new
safety.warning5: Suspicious social media or communication links
safety.warning6: Sudden changes to the transaction terms

levels.title: Safety Levels
levels.subtitle: Choose the appropriate safety level for your transactions
levels.highDesc: Hand-to-hand delivery in a public place

safety.finalNote: Safqa is a C2C marketplace. Following our safety guidelines helps us maintain a trusted community. Direct transaction safety is the responsibility of both the buyer and seller, while we work to provide tools that help support safer transactions.

selling.title: How to Sell on Safqa
selling.description: Follow these simple steps to sell your products quickly and safely
selling.subtitle: Follow these simple steps to sell your products quickly and safely
selling.step1Desc: Start by adding a clear photo and an attractive title for your product.
selling.step2Desc: Add a short and accurate description with the important details for the buyer.
selling.step3Desc: Set an appropriate price. You can add discounts to attract buyers.
selling.step4Desc: Review all the information and then click publish. Your listing will be visible to buyers.
selling.step4Tip2: Make sure your contact information is correct
selling.needHelpDesc: Our support team is ready to help you at every step of your selling journey. We are here to ensure you have the best experience possible.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Terms and conditions for using the Safqa platform
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using the Safqa platform

importantPoints.age: You must be 12 years of age or older to use the platform.
importantPoints.registration: Registration is required to publish listings.
importantPoints.c2c: Safqa is a C2C platform, and users are responsible for buying and selling transactions between themselves.
importantPoints.legalAddress: The platform is subject to the laws and regulations applicable within its relevant jurisdiction.

prohibitedItems.title: Prohibited Products and Activities
prohibitedItems.text: The publication, sale, or purchase of any of the following through the Safqa platform is strictly prohibited. We reserve the right to remove any violating listing and suspend the responsible account without prior notice:
points: Firearms, ammunition, and weapon parts, unless permitted under a valid official license issued by the competent authorities.
Drugs and any substances whose trade is prohibited under Israeli law.
Prescription medications or any pharmaceutical products that are not licensed for sale to the public.
Counterfeit products or products that infringe intellectual property rights or trademarks.
Stolen goods or goods of illegal or undocumented origin.
Alcohol or tobacco products intended for minors.
Hazardous, flammable, or explosive materials and fireworks.
Live animals or products derived from endangered species, in violation of applicable laws.
Sexually explicit or pornographic content or products.
Official documents, personal identification information, or personal information belonging to third parties.
Tickets or services whose resale is prohibited by law.
Any other product or service prohibited by Israeli law or requiring a license that the seller has not obtained.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.text: You must be 12 years of age or older to use the platform. By using the platform, you represent and confirm that you meet this requirement.

registration.title: Registration and Account Creation
registration.text: You are required to create an account in order to publish listings and Listings on the platform. You are responsible for providing accurate and up-to-date information and for keeping your password confidential. We reserve the right to suspend or delete an account in cases of suspicious activity or violations of our Privacy Policy.

products.title: Products and Listings
products.text: Product prices, availability, and descriptions may change at any time. We operate as an intermediary platform and do not guarantee the accuracy of the information provided in listings.

platform.title: Platform and Nature of the Service
platform.text: Safqa is a C2C (consumer-to-consumer) platform that allows users to list and purchase products directly from one another. We do not store the products and do not provide delivery or pickup services.

legalAddress.title: Legal Address
legalAddress.address: Ein Al-Darwa Street, Umm al-Fahm, Israel.
legalAddress.note: This address is considered the official legal address for all legal notices and correspondence.

blocking.title: Blocking and User Interactions
blocking.text: Users may block other users to protect their privacy and prevent unwanted interactions. When a block is active, it applies to both parties according to Safqa's blocking system.
points: When a user blocks another user, both parties are prevented from messaging, sending offers, or directly interacting with each other.
Listings belonging to a blocked user are hidden from the user who initiated the block, and vice versa.
Blocked listings are excluded from search results, categories, and related listings for the other party.
A user cannot access the other party's listings through direct listing URLs while the block is active.
Users can manage their blocked-user list and remove a block at any time.
Safqa may retain blocking records when necessary for security and abuse-prevention purposes.

userConduct.title: User Conduct
points: Do not use the platform for illegal purposes.
Do not impersonate another person or provide false information.
Do not upload malicious code or interfere with the proper operation of the platform.
Do not attempt to access systems that you are not authorized to use.
userConduct.warning: Violations of these terms may result in account suspension, account termination, or legal action.

questions.title: Have Questions?
questions.text: If you have any questions about these Terms of Use, please feel free to contact us.

actions.title: Do you agree to the terms?

deleteAccount.title: Safqa Account Deletion
deleteAccount.subtitle: You can delete your Safqa account and associated data at any time.

intro.title: How to delete your account
intro.text: To permanently delete your account, sign in to your Safqa account, open your Profile page, and follow the account deletion steps.

step1.title: Sign in
step1.text: Sign in to your Safqa account using your account credentials.

step2.title: Open your Profile
step2.text: Open your Profile page from within the application.

step3.title: Select account deletion
step3.text: Scroll to the "Delete Account" section and select the permanent deletion option.

step4.title: Confirm deletion
step4.text: Review the confirmation message and confirm that you want to permanently delete your account.

data.title: Data that is deleted
data.intro: When your account is deleted, data associated with your account is deleted or removed according to Safqa policies. This may include:
data.account: Account information and personal information associated with your account.
data.listings: Listings and information associated with listings you created.
data.images: Images and media that you uploaded to your listings.
data.messages: Data associated with communication and messaging features, subject to applicable data retention requirements.

retention.title: Data that may be retained
retention.text: Some information may be retained for a limited period when required or permitted by law, for security purposes, fraud prevention, dispute resolution, or legal compliance.

warning.title: Important
warning.text: Account deletion is permanent and may not be reversible after the deletion process is completed.

support.title: Unable to access your account?
support.text: If you cannot sign in to your account, use the Safqa support contact method available in the application to request deletion of your account and associated data.

privacy.title: Privacy and data security
privacy.text: We handle user data according to Safqa privacy and security practices.
